summary: Zuranolone carries a boxed warning, the strongest warning from the FDA, because it slows brain activity and impairs the ability to drive or perform hazardous activities for at least 12 hours [3]. This drug can also lead to sleepiness, confusion, and suicidal thoughts or behavior [3]. Additionally, results from a small computer model, rather than tests on people, predict low risk scores for the liver and heart [M].
